def _evaluate_kernel_cell(kernels, cell_nodes, cell_index):
    """
    Evaluate the weighted sum of kernel values on the nodes of a cell.
    """
    return (
        -kernels[cell_nodes[cell_index, 0]]
        + kernels[cell_nodes[cell_index, 1]]
        + kernels[cell_nodes[cell_index, 2]]

        - kernels[cell_nodes[cell_index, 5]]
        - kernels[cell_nodes[cell_index, 6]]
        + kernels[cell_nodes[cell_index, 7]]
    )
